motivation: Adding estimated covariance regularizes the polar direction but need not eliminate substantial zero-population-signal update variance.

construction.reason_for_sandwich: PSD preconditioner guarantees nonnegative alignment with M before normalization; naive nonsymmetric products do not.

limitations: Positive-part selection keeps accidental agreement in pure Gaussian fold noise; signed mean is zero but update variance persists.
Scale normalization prevents larger batches alone from eliminating noise-only false agreement.
Sixteen trajectories and shared online normalization weaken equal-mean/independent-fold assumptions.
Momentum agreement can preserve stale historical directions.
Loewner-order contraction of the preconditioner does not guarantee smaller actual update norm.
Row/column normalization can remove reliable radial movement or alter alignment.
Numerical floors change zero-covariance tail behavior; a matched control is necessary.
decision_gate: Implement only if measured v6 failures concern unreliable spectral directions and independent-heldout gain per policy displacement is improved consistently across partition checks. Do not blindly combine with failed mechanisms.
validation_plan: Queued pure-noise/known-signal synthetic checks of retained RMS and false agreement.
Repeated fixed-batch partition sensitivity, with no independence claim.
Independent-heldout first-order gain per sample Fisher cost versus v6 and zero-noise control.
Radial/tangent update fractions and current-gradient/momentum alignment.
benchmark_requirement: Any proposed trainer gets v9+ descriptive version, fresh HalfCheetah-v4 seed1 8M, CUDA through mlq, explicit max-parallel-runs1, matched control, and prefix-scoped autocull.

analytic_scalar_pure_noise.assumptions: M,N independent centered Gaussian with equal variance; no spectral floor or momentum
analytic_scalar_pure_noise.interpretation: Half the draws are suppressed, but normalized noise variance remains independent of Gaussian scale. This is a scalar analytic counterexample to calibrated confidence, not a matrix-training result.
analytic_scalar_pure_noise.review: Independent mechanism reviewer verified angular integration.
